svg.title: Greenland–Middle Atlantic shelf-current hypothesis: measurement scope
svg.desc: Test continuity and define observed reaches before assigning a system-wide dimension. The proposed connection remains a hypothesis. Member evidence is not inherited by the parent. This is a relationship diagram, not a geographic map.
